# Mini Template

A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.

```sh
bun run src/cli.ts template.txt data.json
bun test.ts
```

Supported syntax: escaped `{{path}}`, unescaped `{{{path}}}`, comments
`{{! comment }}`, nested `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}`, and nested
`{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}`. In loops, `{{this}}` and
`{{@index}}` refer to the current item and index; other paths fall back to
the root data object. Missing values render empty, while objects and functions
are rejected rather than stringified.

90:   if (path === "this") return context.value;
91:   if (path === "@index") return context.index;
92:   const parts = path.split(".");
93:   let value: unknown = context.value;
94:   for (const part of parts) {
95:     if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && part in value) {
96:       value = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
97:     } else {
98:       value = undefined;
99:       break;
100:     }
101:   }
102:   if (value !== undefined || context.value === context.root) return value;
103:   value = context.root;
104:   for (const part of parts) {
105:     if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && part in value) value = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
106:     else return undefined;
107:   }
108:   return value;
109: }

111: function scalar(value: unknown): string {
112:   if (value === undefined || value === null) return "";
113:   if (typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean" || typeof value === "bigint") return String(value);
114:   throw new Error(`Cannot render ${typeof value} as scalar text`);
115: }
116: 
117: function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
118:   return value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({ "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """, "'": "'" })[character]!);
119: }
120: 
121: function truthy(value: unknown): boolean {
122:   return !(value === "" || value === 0 || value === false || value == null || (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0));
123: }

126:   return nodes.map((node) => {
127:     if (node.type === "text") return node.value;
128:     if (node.type === "value") {
129:       const value = scalar(lookup(node.path, context));
130:       return node.escaped ? escapeHtml(value) : value;
131:     }
132:     const value = lookup(node.path, context);
133:     if (node.kind === "if") return renderNodes(truthy(value) ? node.body : node.alternate, context);
134:     if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0) return renderNodes(node.alternate, context);
